data.name: The Last Shootout
data.detailed_description:
NO NANNIES. NO AIM ASSIST. PURE SKILL.

The Last Shootout is an unadulterated, old-school 1v1 FPS duel shooter built for players who miss raw mechanics, instant feedback, and pure skill. No hand-holding and no fluff: just you, your pew, and an opponent across the arena.

KEY FEATURES

  • Old-School 1v1 Duels: Fast, snappy, skill-driven gunplay where reflex, positioning, and aim accuracy dictate every victory.

  • Global Leaderboard Rankings: Prove your dominance online. Win duels, stack kills, and climb the Steam leaderboards to claim the top spot.

  • Offline Bot Practice: Practice your aim in the Bot Practice grounds against distinct AI personalities, ranging from erratic rushdown goblins to pinpoint sharpshooters.

  • Instant Multiplayer Lobbies: Host private matches, join friends via instant join codes, or quick-match into online duels with regional P2P networking.

  • Paintball Impact Feedback: Track every shot with dynamic paint splatters, instant VFX, and spatialized 3D bullet-whiz audio to help you gauge where the shot came from.

GAME MODES

1v1 Competitive Duels

Face off in intense multi-round showdowns. Read your opponent's movement, manage your revolver ammo, and land decisive shots under pressure.

Bot Practice Grounds

Warm up before jumping online. Choose your difficulty, from Rookie to Nightmare, and duel against AI bots programmed with unique movement and targeting behaviors.

THE PHILOSOPHY

We built The Last Shootout to be an affordable and straightforward arena duel game. No battle passes, no pay-to-win, no mandatory tutorials. Just open the game, queue up, and shoot.

data.short_description: Step into the arena for raw, fast-paced 1v1 gunfights! The Last Shootout delivers pure, old-school FPS duels with zero hand-holding. Outshoot opponents in online ranked matches to climb the global leaderboards, or hone your aim against distinct AI bot personalities. Make each shot count.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 8.1 / 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 or equivalent (2GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 8.1 / 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or equivalent (4GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 (Vulkan 1.1 capable)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
